s: man clothed in linen wears linen
q: the man clothed in linen

q: the cloud filled the inner court.

q: fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim

q: Every one of them had four faces.

s: cherubim has part four wings (each cherub)
q: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings.

q: there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub.

s: cherubim moves straight forward (each goes without turning)
q: They each went straight forward.

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) has appearance beryl stone
q: The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) has count four
q: there were four wheels beside the cherubim

q: Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

s: the LORD judges house of Israel (in the border of Israel)
q: I will judge you in the border of Israel.

s: the LORD is sanctuary to the exiles (Ezekiel's brothers) (for a little while in the countries)
q: yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

s: the exiles (Ezekiel's brothers) is scattered among nations (removed far off by the LORD)
q: Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries

q: I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

s: inhabitants of Jerusalem claim possession of land of Israel (say it was given to them)
q: ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

s: the exiles (Ezekiel's brothers) is located in Chaldea (as captives)

s: the LORD will give heart heart of flesh (replacing stony heart, to the restored people)
q: I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

s: the LORD is god of the exiles (Ezekiel's brothers) (covenant relationship promised to the restored)

s: the LORD has glory over cherubim (glory of the God of Israel above them)
q: The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

s: the LORD has glory located at mountain on the east side of the city (glory went up from the city and stood there)
q: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

s: Pelatiah the son of Benaiah has father Benaiah
q: Pelatiah the son of Benaiah

s: Pelatiah the son of Benaiah is member of twenty-five men (seen among them at the east gate)
q: I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

s: twenty-five men devise iniquity (and give wicked counsel in the city)
q: these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

s: cauldron and meat saying is a saying of the twenty-five men (claims the city is the cauldron and they are the meat)
q: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

s: house of Israel has filled Jerusalem (with the slain in its streets)
q: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.

s: house of Israel has not walked in the LORD's statutes (also has not executed his ordinances)
q: for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances

s: house of Israel follows ordinances of the nations (nations around them)
q: but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

s: Ezekiel dwells in house of Israel (in the middle of the rebellious house)

s: the LORD disperses house of Israel (among the nations so they will know he is the LORD)
q: They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

s: the LORD spares survivors (a few men from sword, famine and pestilence)
q: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come.

s: inhabitants of Jerusalem experience fearfulness (eat bread with fearfulness and drink water in dismay)
q: They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay

s: land of Israel will become desolate (because of the violence of its inhabitants)
q: that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

s: proverb about prolonged days and failing visions states the days are prolonged and every vision fails (current in the land of Israel)
q: what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

s: the LORD will end proverb about prolonged days and failing visions (it will no more be used in Israel)
q: I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;

s: fulfillment of the LORD's word is near every vision (no more deferred)
q: The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

s: the LORD performs his spoken word (will not be deferred)
q: I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred

q: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

s: house of Israel has disposition rebellious (has eyes and ears but neither sees nor hears)
q: who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

s: Ezekiel is a sign to the house of Israel (set by the LORD)
q: for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

s: prince in Jerusalem located in Jerusalem
q: This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.

s: prince in Jerusalem will die in Babylon (taken in the LORD's net and snare; will not see it)

s: Babylon located in Chaldea (land of the Chaldeans)
q: I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans

s: the LORD scatters followers and bands of the prince (toward every wind, with the sword drawn after them)
q: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

s: false prophets of Israel is compared to foxes (in the waste places)
q: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

s: false prophets of Israel seduces souls (the LORD's people, saying 'Peace')
q: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace.

s: whitewashed wall is destined to fall (brought down to the ground, foundation uncovered)
q: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered.

s: whitewashed wall is destroyed by storm of judgment (stormy wind, shower, hailstones)
q: I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

s: storm of judgment consists of stormy wind, overflowing shower and great hailstones (sent in the LORD's wrath)
q: There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

s: the LORD commands Ezekiel (to prophesy against false prophets)
q: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy

s: Ezekiel is addressed as son of man
q: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy

s: women who prophesy (daughters of your people) prophesies from their own heart
q: the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart

s: women who prophesy (daughters of your people) uses magic bands and veils (to hunt souls)

s: women who prophesy (daughters of your people) profanes the LORD (for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread)
q: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread

s: magic bands and veils is opposed by the LORD (will tear them away and free the souls)

s: false prophets of Israel prophesies from their own heart (not sent by the LORD)
q: prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart

s: false visions and lying divination is claimed falsely as the LORD's word (the LORD has not spoken)

s: the LORD will deliver souls (his people, from the hands of the false prophetesses)
q: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand

s: the LORD has people Israel (the house of Israel)

s: false prophets of Israel follows their own spirit (have seen nothing)

s: false prophets of Israel has not been sent by the LORD (claim 'The LORD says')

s: false prophets of Israel fails to build up the wall for Israel (did not go up into the gaps)
q: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.

s: false prophets of Israel opposed by the LORD (judgment for false visions)

s: false prophets of Israel excluded from the council of my people (also not written in the writing of the house of Israel nor entering the land)
q: They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel.

s: false prophets of Israel prophesies peace for Jerusalem (there is no peace)
q: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace

s: false prophets of Israel plasters whitewashed wall (with whitewash)
q: When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

s: Noah is a righteous man (delivers only own soul by righteousness)

s: Jerusalem has remnant (sons and daughters carried out)

s: remnant comforts Ezekiel (by their way and doings)
q: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings;

q: If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

s: Daniel is a righteous man (delivers only own soul by righteousness)
q: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,”

s: Job is a righteous man (delivers only own soul by righteousness)
q: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,”

s: the LORD refuses inquiry from elders of Israel (because they have idols in their hearts)
q: these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

s: elders of Israel holds in heart idols
q: these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face.

s: house of Israel is estranged from the LORD (through their idols)
q: because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

s: the LORD calls to repent house of Israel (turn from idols and abominations)
q: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

s: the LORD has covenant relationship with house of Israel (intended outcome of judgment)
q: but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,”

s: Jerusalem receives sword, famine, and pestilence (sword, famine, evil animals, pestilence)
q: when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

s: the LORD speaks to Ezekiel (word came to him)
q: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

s: vine tree is among trees of the forest
q: the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

s: vine tree is suitable for no work (even when whole)
q: when it was whole, it was suitable for no work.

s: vine tree is used as fuel (cast into the fire)
q: it is cast into the fire for fuel

s: fire devours inhabitants of Jerusalem (even after they go out from the fire)
q: They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them.

s: inhabitants of Jerusalem acts unfaithfully (reason for desolation of the land)
q: because they have acted unfaithfully,”

s: land becomes desolate (by the LORD's action)
q: I will make the land desolate,

s: Jerusalem has origin Canaanite (land of origin and birth)

s: Jerusalem has reputation renowned among the nations (for her beauty)
q: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty;

s: Jerusalem has disposition insatiable (in prostitution with Assyrians)

s: Jerusalem will be restored with Samaria (will return to former estate)

s: Samaria has sin level less than half of Jerusalem's
q: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins;

q: I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

s: Jerusalem's lovers are paid by Jerusalem (she gives gifts and bribes)
q: but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them,

q: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters;

q: and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

q: but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

s: Jerusalem has attribute exceedingly beautiful (through God's majesty)

s: house of Israel has disposition rebellious

s: cedar (Lebanon's cedar) located in Lebanon
q: came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

s: great eagle (first, Babylon's king) represents Babylon (king of Babylon)

s: great eagle (second, Pharaoh) has feature great wings and many feathers
q: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers.

s: vine (planted by the eagle) has stature low (spreading vine)
q: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him.

s: vine (planted by the eagle) planted in good soil by many waters (so it might bear fruit and be a good vine)
q: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.

s: Judah's king (Zedekiah, royal offspring) is a royal offspring (taken by the king of Babylon)
q: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him.

s: Judah's king (Zedekiah, royal offspring) bound by covenant and oath with Babylon (made with the king of Babylon)
q: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath

s: Judah's king (Zedekiah, royal offspring) rebelled against Babylon (by sending ambassadors into Egypt)
q: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people.

s: Judah's king (Zedekiah, royal offspring) will die in Babylon (decreed by the Lord GOD)
q: surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

s: the LORD owns all souls (both father and son)
q: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine.

s: righteous man (just man) has father of robber son (son of the just man)
q: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

s: robber son (son of the just man) is a robber who sheds blood
q: a son who is a robber who sheds blood

s: robber son (son of the just man) receives death (for his abominations)
q: He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

s: robber son (son of the just man) lends with interest (takes increase from the poor)
q: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor

s: righteous grandson (son of the robber) receives life (does not die for his father's iniquity)
q: he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

s: righteous grandson (son of the robber) refrains from his father's sins (sees them, fears, and does not do likewise)
q: who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise

s: righteous grandson (son of the robber) walks in God's statutes
q: has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes

s: individual responsibility for sin states the soul who sins shall die (son does not bear father's iniquity, nor father the son's)
q: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son.

s: individual responsibility for sin assigns righteousness and wickedness to the individual
q: The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

s: wicked man receives life (if he turns from all his sins and keeps God's statutes)
q: if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

s: the LORD forbids sour grapes proverb (Israel's saying) (in Israel)
q: you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

s: wicked man has transgressions not remembered (after he turns)
q: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him.

s: repentance and return results in life (God has no pleasure in death)
q: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

s: repentance and return requires a new heart and a new spirit (casting away transgressions)
q: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit.

s: individual responsibility and repentance is affirmed by the LORD (contrasted with Israel's unfair ways)
q: House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

s: the LORD takes pleasure in return of the wicked (rather than their death)
q: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

s: the LORD judges house of Israel (each according to his ways)
q: Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD.

s: house of Israel uses sour grapes proverb (Israel's saying) (concerning the land of Israel)
q: What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel

s: house of Israel claims the Lord's way is not fair (complaint against God)
q: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’

s: sour grapes proverb (Israel's saying) states fathers eat sour grapes and children's teeth are set on edge (implies children bear fathers' guilt)
q: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’

s: righteous man (just man) receives life (because he is just and keeps God's statutes)
q: he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.

s: righteous man (just man) gives bread to the hungry (and clothes the naked)
q: has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

s: lioness (mother of the princes) is a lioness (mother of the princes)
q: What was your mother? A lioness.

s: nations captured second cub (young lion taken to Babylon) (attacked on every side and netted)
q: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him.

s: nations captured first cub (young lion taken to Egypt) (in their pit)
q: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit;

s: vine (mother of the princes) is a vine (mother of the princes, in their blood)
q: Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters.

s: vine (mother of the princes) has attribute fruitful (by reason of many waters)
q: It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

s: vine (mother of the princes) has part strong branches (for scepters of rulers)
q: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled.

s: vine (mother of the princes) is planted in wilderness (dry and thirsty land)
q: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

s: vine (mother of the princes) has state no strong branch to rule (fire devoured its fruit)
q: It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.

s: lamentation for the princes of Israel is a lamentation
q: This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

s: lamentation for the princes of Israel is about princes of Israel
q: take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

s: lioness (mother of the princes) couches among lions
q: She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.

s: first cub (young lion taken to Egypt) is a young lion (cub of the lioness)

s: first cub (young lion taken to Egypt) has habit devouring men (learned to catch prey)
q: He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

s: first cub (young lion taken to Egypt) is held in Egypt (brought with hooks after capture in the nations' pit)
q: He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

s: second cub (young lion taken to Babylon) is a young lion (second cub of the lioness)
q: then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.

s: second cub (young lion taken to Babylon) has habit devouring men (learned to catch prey)
q: He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

s: second cub (young lion taken to Babylon) laid waste cities (knew their palaces)
q: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities.

s: second cub (young lion taken to Babylon) is held by king of Babylon (caged and brought into strongholds)
q: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon.

s: Ezekiel is a priest
q: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi

s: cherubim has faces four (each creature)
q: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

s: cherubim has wings four (each creature)
q: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

s: cherubim has feet straight, like a calf's foot (sparkled like burnished bronze)
q: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

s: cherubim has hands hands of a man (under their wings)
q: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides.

s: cherubim has face man, lion, ox, eagle (lion on right, ox on left)
q: they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

s: cherubim moves straight forward (without turning)
q: They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

s: cherubim has appearance burning coals of fire (like torches)
q: their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches.

s: cherubim goes where led by spirit
q: Where the spirit was to go, they went.

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) has appearance beryl (a wheel within a wheel)
q: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl.

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) has rims high and dreadful, full of eyes
q: their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

s: Ezekiel son of Buzi
q: Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) moves with cherubim (go, stand, and lift up together)
q: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood.

s: wheels (beside the living creatures) contains spirit (spirit of the living creature)
q: the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels

s: sapphire throne (above the cherubim) is located above the expanse
q: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne

s: sapphire throne (above the cherubim) has appearance sapphire stone
q: the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone.

s: man-like figure (on the throne) sits on sapphire throne (above the cherubim)
q: On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

s: man-like figure (on the throne) has appearance glowing metal and fire, with brightness around (waist upward glowing metal; waist downward fire)
q: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

s: man-like figure (on the throne) is a likeness of the LORD's glory (brightness like a rainbow)
q: This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory.

s: visions of God occurs at river Chebar
q: as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

s: Ezekiel located in land of the Chaldeans (when the vision came)
q: in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar

s: Ezekiel located at river Chebar (among the captives)
q: as I was among the captives by the river Chebar

s: Ezekiel is among the exiles (Ezekiel's brothers)
q: as I was among the captives by the river Chebar

s: Ezekiel experiences visions of God
q: the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God

s: the LORD has hand on Ezekiel
q: the LORD’s hand was there on him

s: cherubim number four
q: the likeness of four living creatures

s: cherubim has likeness man
q: They had the likeness of a man.

s: the LORD is a God of Israel
q: I am the LORD your God.

s: Ezekiel is a prophet (receives the LORD's word)
q: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

s: Ezekiel has reputation as speaker of parables (said by people about him)
q: They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’

s: fathers (of the children of Israel) rebelled against the LORD (in Egypt and the wilderness, not forsaking idols)
q: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness.

s: fathers (of the children of Israel) worship at Bamah (high places on hills and under trees)
q: they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices

s: Israel practices child sacrifice (passing firstborn through the fire) (continuing to this day)
q: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day?

s: Israel will be scattered among nations (sworn by the LORD in the wilderness)
q: I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries

s: Israel desires to be like nations (serving wood and stone)
q: We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

s: promised land (flowing with milk and honey) is described as glory of all lands (flowing with milk and honey)
q: flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

s: Egypt has idols (Israel was told not to defile themselves with them)
q: Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.

s: the LORD sanctifies Israel (through the Sabbaths given as a sign)
q: that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

s: statutes and ordinances gives life (to the man who keeps them)
q: which if a man does, he will live in them.

s: judgment of Israel takes place in wilderness of the peoples (face to face)
q: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

s: gathering and return of Israel leads to land of Israel (LORD gathers them from the countries)
q: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

s: fire (kindled in the southern forest) consumes every green tree and every dry tree (kindled by the LORD, not quenched)
q: I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree.

s: forest of the south is target of prophecy (Ezekiel told to prophesy against it)
q: prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

s: the LORD chose Israel (in Egypt, swore to the offspring of Jacob)
q: In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob

s: the LORD refuses inquiry from elders of Israel (because of Israel's idolatry)
q: Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will not be inquired of by you.

s: the LORD will be king over Israel (with mighty hand, outstretched arm and poured out wrath)
q: surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

s: the LORD acts for the sake of his name (so it is not profaned among the nations)
q: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were

s: the LORD gave statutes and ordinances (to Israel in the wilderness)
q: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

s: the LORD gave Sabbaths (as a sign between him and Israel)
q: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them

s: elders of Israel visit Ezekiel (came to inquire of the LORD and sat before him)
q: some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.

s: Ezekiel is addressed as son of man (title used by the LORD)
q: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

s: Jerusalem is located in Judah (described as fortified)
q: and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

s: prince of Israel is described as deadly wounded wicked one (his day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end)
q: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

s: prince of Israel is commanded to remove turban and crown (the order will not be as it was)
q: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was.

s: children of Ammon is target of sword (the LORD's sword) (polished for slaughter)
q: The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

s: children of Ammon has visions false visions (lying divination)
q: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you,

s: children of Ammon will be judged in land of its birth (where it was created)
q: In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

s: princes of Israel are delivered to sword (the LORD's sword) (along with my people)
q: It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people.

s: the LORD is against Israel (will cut off righteous and wicked)
q: Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

s: sword (the LORD's sword) is drawn by the LORD (will not return to its sheath)
q: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

s: sword (the LORD's sword) is state sharpened and polished (to slaughter and flash like lightning)
q: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning.

s: sword (the LORD's sword) is given to killer (to be handled)
q: Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’

s: king of Babylon wields sword (the LORD's sword) (the sword of the king of Babylon)
q: appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come.

s: king of Babylon uses divination (arrows, teraphim, liver)
q: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

s: king of Babylon has lot for Jerusalem (in his right hand)
q: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams,

s: Rabbah belongs to children of Ammon (of the children of Ammon)
q: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

s: Jerusalem is a bloody city
q: Will you judge the bloody city?

s: priests (Jerusalem's priests) do violence to God's law (profane holy things; no distinction between holy and common)
q: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things.

s: priests (Jerusalem's priests) hide eyes from Sabbaths
q: and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths.

s: people of the land practice oppression and robbery (trouble the poor and needy; oppress the foreigner)
q: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery.

s: people of the land oppress foreigner (wrongfully)
q: have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

s: Israel is to the lord dross (house of Israel)
q: the house of Israel has become dross to me.

s: Israel is composed of bronze, tin, iron, and lead (in the middle of the furnace)
q: All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace.

s: dross is a dross of silver
q: They are the dross of silver.

s: the LORD will gather israel in Jerusalem (to melt them in anger like a furnace)
q: therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

s: the LORD will scatter Israel (among the nations, to purge filthiness)
q: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries.

s: the LORD is profaned by priests (Jerusalem's priests)
q: So I am profaned among them.

s: Jerusalem sheds bloodshed (within herself)
q: A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come

s: the LORD found no one to stand in the gap (sought a man to build up the wall)
q: I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
